## If you are adding an entry to AWESOME.md

- [ ] The entry sits at the bottom of the right section and uses the exact two-line shape.
- [ ] The code is public and free to use, the model weights can be downloaded for free, and both licences are stated.
- [ ] It needs no paid API key and no cloud call at run time.
- [ ] It says what hardware it was run on, and either a measured number or "not measured".
- [ ] `python _scripts/check_awesome.py` passes (add `--links` to check the URLs).

## If you are adding a measurement or a recipe

- [ ] The CSV or recipe follows `code/common/benchmarks/METHODOLOGY.md` or `code/_template/`.
- [ ] No numbers were copied from elsewhere.
